entry.title: Notice on Recipients of Autumn 2026 Imperial Decorations and Medals of Honor
entry.summary: 令和８年秋の叙勲・褒章受章者について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 4, 2026The Financial Services Agency announced the recipients of the Autumn 2026 Order of Merit and Medals of Honor. The decorations were approved at Cabinet meetings in October and issued on November 3. Seventeen FSA-related individuals received the Order of Merit, and eighteen received Medals of Honor.

entry.title: Notice of the 3rd meeting of the Financial System Council's Working Group on the supply of funds to growth companies
entry.summary: 金融審議会「成長企業への資金供給の在り方等に関するワーキング・グループ」（第３回）の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 2, 2026 · MeetingThe Financial Services Agency announced the third meeting of the Financial System Council's Working Group on the supply of funds to growth companies. The meeting will be held on November 9, 2026, from 10:00 to 12:00, at the Central Government Building No. 7 and online. The agenda includes three hearings, two secretariat briefings and a discussion. There is no public gallery, but the meeting will be streamed on YouTube, and minutes will be posted on the FSA website afterward.

entry.title: FATF Statement Published After October 2026 Plenary
entry.summary: 国際関係,FATF声明の公表について（2026年10月プレナリー）掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 2, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Action Task Force (FATF) adopted and published a statement at its October 2026 plenary identifying jurisdictions with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing deficiencies. The list covers "high-risk jurisdictions subject to a call for action" and "jurisdictions under increased monitoring." Japan's Financial Services Agency announced it on November 2, 2026, with past statements linked for reference.

entry.title: FSA Updates Status of Loan Condition Modifications at Financial Institutions
entry.summary: その他,金融機関における貸付条件の変更等の状況についてを更新しました。 金融庁 · Oct 30, 2026 · ReportThe Financial Services Agency updated its tally of loan condition modifications made by financial institutions in response to U.S. tariff measures, covering data through the end of September 2026. entry.title: FSA notice listing consultation contacts for victims of personal data leaks
entry.summary: その他,個人情報流出の被害に遭われた方・ご心配のある方向けの相談窓口について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Oct 30, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Services Agency posted a notice listing consultation counters for people affected by or worried about personal data leaks. entry.title: Japanese Government comment letter on EFRAG's Exposure Draft of ESRS-40a sustainability reporting standards for non-EU companies
entry.summary: 国際関係,欧州財務報告諮問グループ（EFRAG）による「非EU企業向け欧州サステナビリティ報告基準（ESRS-40a）公開草案」へのコメントレター発出について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 30, 2026 · GuidanceThe Japanese Government issued a comment letter on October 28, 2026, on EFRAG's ESRS-40a Exposure Draft published July 23, 2026. It supports incorporation by reference of ISSB-aligned group sustainability reports and the mixed approach. It proposes clarifying ESRS-40a-specific top-up disclosures and introducing a simpler company-based alternative mixed approach.

entry.title: IFRS Foundation Monitoring Board press release on new leadership, governance and accountability
entry.summary: 国際関係,国際会計基準（IFRS）財団モニタリング・ボードのプレスリリースについて公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 30, 2026 · ReportThe IFRS Foundation Monitoring Board met in Amsterdam on October 21-22, 2026, and issued a press release on October 29, 2026. The meeting discussed the Trustees' oversight of the IASB and ISSB, the Foundation's funding and governance model, proposed amendments to its Constitution, and the importance of due process and post-implementation reviews. The Board reaffirmed its support for developing high-quality, globally trusted accounting and sustainability disclosure standards.

entry.title: Publication of Amendment to FSA Notice Designating Accounting Standards for Consolidated Financial Statements and Public Comment Results
entry.summary: 「連結財務諸表の用語、様式及び作成方法に関する規則に規定する金融庁長官が定める企業会計の基準を指定する件の一部を改正する件」の公布及びパブリックコメントの結果の公表 金融庁 · Sep 29, 2026 · RuleThe Financial Services Agency published an amendment to its notice designating accounting standards under the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation and released the results of a public comment period, which drew two comments. The amendment adds IFRS 20 Regulatory Assets and Regulatory Liabilities to the designated international accounting standards and removes IFRS 14 Regulatory Deferral Accounts. The amended notice takes effect on the date of publication.

entry.title: FSA Announces Japan Global Capital Markets Conference Held October 2026
entry.summary: 国際関係,「Japan Global Capital Markets Conference」の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 29, 2026 · MeetingThe Financial Services Agency held the Japan Global Capital Markets Conference on 19 October 2026 under the theme of maintaining trust while capital markets evolve. Regulators, IOSCO representatives, market participants and experts took part in three panel discussions on innovation and market integrity, public market revitalization, and private markets. Participants agreed that market trust underpins sustainable capital market development and that ongoing dialogue and international cooperation are important.
